detail.en: The Rex Modules row on Discover, the Import Rex Subscription row in Settings and the code behind them are removed. A Rex subscription saved earlier is cleared from this app.
detail.zh-Hans: 发现页的 Rex 模块一行、设置里的“导入 Rex 订阅”以及相关功能代码已移除。此前在应用里保存的 Rex 订阅会被清除。

title.en: Danmaku, Sharper Picture and Smooth Motion removed
title.zh-Hans: 弹幕、画质增强、补帧已移除

detail.en: The danmaku, Sharper Picture and Smooth Motion features, their settings and their code are gone from iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Bilibili's danmaku count in video details stays.
detail.zh-Hans: 弹幕、画质增强、补帧功能及其设置、代码已从 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和 Apple TV 版移除。视频详情里 B 站的弹幕数仍保留。

title.en: App icons: Pocket, Seal and Shiba only
title.zh-Hans: 应用图标只保留口袋、海豹、柴犬

detail.en: The other app icon choices are removed. A previously chosen icon that no longer exists falls back to Pocket.
detail.zh-Hans: 其余应用图标选项已移除。之前选过的已删除图标会回到口袋。

title.en: Rex import is easier to find

detail.en: The Rex Modules row now sits right under the featured titles on Discover, also after a subscription is imported or when Featured Titles is hidden. Settings has an Import Rex Subscription row, and the import list shows each subscription's module count. Only module collections can be imported; a whole Rex home layout cannot. Checked in the simulator with the offline sample only.
detail.zh-Hans: 发现页的 Rex 模块一行固定放在推荐区下方，导入后或隐藏推荐区时也一样；设置里新增“导入 Rex 订阅”，导入列表显示每个订阅的模块数。目前只能导入模块合集，不能导入整套 Rex 首页布局。只在模拟器里用离线样例检查过。

detail.en: Discover has a Rex Modules row. Import a Rex subscription address, and modules that are plain JavaScript list modules open as a browsable grid. Encrypted modules and modules that need an HTML loader or TMDB lookup are shown as not supported. Only the built-in offline sample has been checked in the simulator; importing a real address over the network, video-source modules and Apple TV are not done.
detail.zh-Hans: 发现页新增“Rex 模块”一行。导入 Rex 订阅地址后，未加密的纯 JavaScript 列表模块可在应用内以网格浏览；加密模块、需要 HTML 加载或 TMDB 查询的模块会标为暂不支持。目前只在模拟器里用内置离线样例检查过；真实网络导入、视频源模块和 Apple TV 尚未完成。

detail.en: Tap the source name at the top of a source page to open a half sheet: subscription groups as chips on top, sources below. Pick one and the page switches without going back.
detail.zh-Hans: 点源页面顶部的源名称，弹出半屏面板：订阅分组芯片在上、源列表在下，选一个即可就地切换，无需返回。

title.en: Discover opens with the title card

detail.en: Opening a Douban title now shows its cover and name at once while it is matched, instead of a blank spinner. Matches are cached for the session. This helps how the wait looks; it does not make the network faster.
detail.zh-Hans: 打开豆瓣条目时先显示封面和标题，再在后台匹配，不再是空白转圈；匹配结果在本次使用中缓存。这改善等待时的观感，并不会让网络变快。

title.en: Source search runs more in parallel

detail.en: Native sources are searched up to 8 at a time (scripts stay at 4). Play still stays grey until a real playable target is ready. Speed-up is not measured yet.
detail.zh-Hans: 原生片源最多同时搜索 8 个（脚本源仍为 4）。播放键仍须等到真实可播目标就绪才亮。提速效果尚未实测。

title.en: Top Play goes through the cancellable path
title.zh-Hans: 顶部播放键走可取消流程

detail.en: The top Play button on a source page now starts playback through the same cancellable request as other entries. Verified by code and build only; real touch and on-device behavior are not yet verified.
detail.zh-Hans: 源页面顶部播放键改为与其他入口相同的可取消请求。仅经代码与编译验证；真实触摸与真机表现尚未验证。

title.en: Waits for the real first frame

detail.en: The player no longer drops the loading screen on a timer: it holds until video frames are actually drawing. A stream that plays sound with no picture (6s) or buffers without a picture (20s) now names the failure and tries the next line; audio-only playback is unaffected. Not yet verified end to end: the 6s and 20s branches have no simulator scene evidence. Playback issues with specific sources are still being investigated.
detail.zh-Hans: 播放器不再按固定时间收起加载界面，而是等到视频真正开始绘制。遇有声无画（6 秒）或长时间缓冲无画面（20 秒）会明确提示并自动尝试下一条线路；纯音频播放不受影响。6 秒、20 秒两个分支尚无模拟器场景证据，未完整验证；个别片源的播放问题仍在排查中。

detail.en: Fixed: for a new revision the sheet could stay empty or never open when the package lacked the revision marker; it now falls back to the bundled notes.
detail.zh-Hans: 修复：安装包缺少修订标记时，新修订的「版本新功能」可能空白或不弹出；现在回退到随包内置的说明。

detail.en: What's New ships inside the package now, so it opens without a network connection.
detail.zh-Hans: 「版本新功能」内容随安装包提供，没有网络也能打开查看。

detail.en: Each 1.8.32 revision (R1, R2, R3) lists its own real changes instead of one shared list.
detail.zh-Hans: 1.8.32 各修订（R1、R2、R3）分别展示本修订的真实改动，不再共用同一份说明。

title.en: Music stays in the tab bar
title.zh-Hans: 音乐模块固定到导航栏

detail.en: Music no longer disappears when a subscription is removed; it uses the sources in your music source list.
detail.zh-Hans: 删除订阅后音乐模块不再消失，改为使用音乐源列表中的音源。

detail.en: A managed LX music source added once on first launch. Disable or delete it anytime; it is never re-added.
detail.zh-Hans: 受管理的 LX 音乐源，仅首次启动时添加一次。可随时停用或删除，不会再次自动添加。

title.zh-Hans: 设置页移除「贡献者」区块

detail.en: The contributors list and its sort note are gone from Settings on every platform; open-source licenses stay.
detail.zh-Hans: 设置中的贡献者列表及排序说明已在各平台移除，开源许可保留。

detail.en: The version number carries an R revision label (like 1.8.32 R2), and Settings again links to these notes.
detail.zh-Hans: 版本号加入 R 修订号（如 1.8.32 R2），设置页恢复「版本新功能」入口。

detail.en: Failover gating, keeping failed sources on record, and loading-state work. Code and tests are in place; real-source playback verification is still in progress.
detail.zh-Hans: 换源门禁、保留失败线路记录与加载状态等改动。代码与测试已就绪，真实源播放验证仍在进行中。

detail.en: Discover detail lists playable sources under each episode, so one tap starts playback.
detail.zh-Hans: 发现页详情在剧集下方直接列出可播线路，点选即可播放。
